about_the_game:
WELCOME TO RAPTORS VS. GOBLINS

Defeat hordes of goblins in a classic 5-Lane tower defense. Build your deck of cards and upgrade your arsenal of gear to provide the best defense. Explore the adventure mode to unlock that new gear and take down the goblins once and for all.


As well as your troops you decide to bring into battle, YOU TOO are to help aid in the fight. Equip your gun and defend the barricade from goblin breach! Collect bones that spawn from your quarries or from natural spawn to upgrade your placed troops and expand your army! The player will also need to watch their ammo as well. Pick up ammo supplies that spawn to give yourself extra ammo supply to take down those wretched goblins.

You will have many guns at your disposal and to discover! Some examples include;

  • The Starter - Classic pistol, sturdy, and outclassed.

  • The Classic Shotgun - It's in the name, it's a classic. Fire at will but beware its damage drop-off! Deals high initial damage, but as the bullet travels it gets weaker.

  • Automatic Rifle - Fast and reliable, keeping it consistent at least.

  • The Recycler - It's only you! All bullets that you create load into this beast, causing an unleashed demon of lasers.

And even more...

The GOBLIN KING STRIKES, and it's up to you to defeat him. Explore ADVENTURE MODE, complete curated levels, and challenges and fight your way to the top! Unlock new weapons, troops, buildings, spells, etc, as you go through the treacherous path. Explore new areas and build up your arsenal as you play. Play new arcade missions and unlock challenge levels that completely alter the rules.

Use your bone stockpile to repair your village and unlock even MORE upgrades and new content. Explore the bounty board to play Hunts and Onslaught challenges to earn even more bones. Gunther Gunporium and Fashion Statement's is open in each map as well. Purchase new cosmetics and weaponry from him to either get crazy or get fancy.

A lot can be changed about your player loadout, like your gun's cards, etc. Let's take a look at that.

GUNS & the not so FIREARMS

Starter pistol not doing it for you? Change your weapon based on the unlock guns that you have collected thus far. Some may not even be guns. That's for you to discover.

DRESSING ROOM

Want a new look? Change your Raptor's colour, a Hat (if it suits your fancy), and even a face piece to make your Raptor just a little more stylish in battle.

DECK BUILDER

As you unlock more cards, you get to build a more expansive deck. Custom decks are used in arcade/challenge levels or Adventure missions that don't have a preset deck. Be strategic about what you bring into battle, each card can make or break your play.

LEVEL UPGRADES

As you open the shop, you will have level upgrades that you can purchase, these three upgrades are divvied up into three categories;

  • BONES - Enhances the way you collect bones

  • ARENA - Gives an extra upgrade to an arena element

  • PLAYER - Gives the player an upgrade or extra ability

You will unlock new types of upgrades to put in your build that will follow these three categories, from auto collectors to large rockets, and even a shield that gives you a second chance.

Play levels and challenges that are located in the arcade. All these levels are readily accessible and use the gear and cards you've unlocked thus far. Play classic ONSLAUGHT, and infinite wave showdown where you just go for as long as you can for a fight of score. Play other random assortment of challenges as well that are more basic at core but allow for quick fun, like one lane only, or buildings only, etc. No unlocks necessary, you will have these modes right away!

Want to keep a close eye on the game and progress? Or even future updates for playtesting and contests? Join the discord or keep an eye on my YouTube!

and most importantly, have an awesome day (:

short_description: When two unorthodox worlds collide, you get RAPTORS VS. GOBLINS. Fight off hordes of goblins and defend your kingdom! Reclaim what's yours and keep fighting to get stronger. Throw the Goblin King out of the ranks and save the Island in this 5-Lane tower defense!
